title: scandix pecten-veneris f. involucrata
intro: Scandix pecten-veneris f. involucrata, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species within the Carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions, such as pain and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Scandix pecten-veneris f. involucrata include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
